notice.en: Every workout in this file is newly authored to replace an empty Base-APK placeholder. None is recovered Street Gymnastic Pro content.

step_semantics.en: Exactly one of reps or seconds is normally set. Repetitions are per side for unilateral movements. Tempo 3011 means 3 seconds lowering, 0 pause, 1 second lifting, 1 second reset.

readiness.en: Begin only if normal daily movement is pain-free and the warm-up does not reveal sharp pain or unusual weakness.

fallback.en: Use the listed regression, reduce one set, or change the day to an easy walk plus cooldown. Quality always outranks the written target.

stop.en: Stop for sharp pain, numbness, dizziness, instability, or a sudden loss of strength. End every set before form fails.

assessment.rule: A target counts only with pain-free form and no grinding; retest another day if warm-up readiness is poor.

description.en: Close Level 1 with easy movement, record the gates honestly, and repeat or advance without shame.

handoff.advance_when: All five fundamentals are pain-free and the hang/support targets are controlled on a rested day.
